# Factory CLI

R2-backed artifact registry CLI.

## Usage

```bash
bun run factory --version
bun run factory:publish ./dist.tgz --name my-lib --version 1.0.0
bun run factory:list
bun run factory:search event-store
bun run factory:install my-lib
bun run factory:readme my-lib
bun run factory create factory-library my-new-lib --publish
```

## Environment

Set `R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` for registry access.
Optional: `FACTORY_REGISTRY_URL`, `BUN_CREATE_DIR`, `FACTORY_NO_COLOR`.

# `@tennis-hq/ssot`

**Publish-only** package for Tennis HQ governance artifacts (MIT).

The root app (`tennis-hq`) stays **`private: true`** and is never published.

| Export | Contents |
|--------|----------|
| `@tennis-hq/ssot` | `SSOT_VERSION`, `COLOR_KEYS`, loaders |
| `@tennis-hq/ssot/color-system.json` | Kernel color registry |
| `@tennis-hq/ssot/glossary-colors.json` | Glossary color wire |

## From monorepo root

```bash
bun run colors:build
bun run ssot:build
bun run ssot:check
bun run ssot:pack          # artifacts/publish/*.tgz — no auth
bun run ssot:publish       # needs NPM_TOKEN or npm login
```

## Version

```bash
bun pm version patch --no-git-tag-version   # root
bun run ssot:build                          # sync + artifacts
```

## Config

- `publishConfig.access`: **public** (free scoped package)
- `private`: false
- `files`: dist, registry, README, LICENSE

# `@tennis-hq/ssot`

**Publish-only** package for Tennis HQ governance artifacts and transport-safe domain contracts (MIT).

The root app (`tennis-hq`) stays **`private: true`** and is never published.

| Export                                       | Contents                              |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `@tennis-hq/ssot`                            | `SSOT_VERSION`, `COLOR_KEYS`, loaders |
| `@tennis-hq/ssot/color-system.json`          | Kernel color registry                 |
| `@tennis-hq/ssot/glossary-colors.json`       | Glossary color wire                   |
| `@tennis-hq/ssot/contracts/v1/manifest.json` | Five-domain runtime contract manifest |
| `@tennis-hq/ssot/contracts/v1/*.schema.json` | Common and domain JSON Schemas        |

The v1 runtime domains are `marketdata`, `research`, `trading`, `partners`, and
`accounting`. Runtime routes require `PARTNER_API_TOKEN` (or the provider-side
`OPERATOR_API_TOKEN` alias). `FACTORY_WAGER_TOKEN` remains registry/package
authentication and is not accepted by the runtime API.

## From monorepo root

```bash
bun run colors:build
bun run ssot:build
bun run ssot:check
bun run ssot:pack          # artifacts/publish/*.tgz — no auth
bun run ssot:publish       # needs NPM_TOKEN or npm login
```

## Version

```bash
bun pm version patch --no-git-tag-version   # root
bun run ssot:build                          # sync + artifacts
```

## Config

- `publishConfig.access`: **public** (free scoped package)
- `private`: false
- `files`: dist, registry, README, LICENSE

0.1.0.readme:
# @factorywager/bookmakers

Canonical bookmaker registry for the sportsbook deep-link pipeline — published to
the FactoryWager **artifact registry** (`registry.factory-wager.com`, R2-backed),
not npm.

## Schema

Each entry key is the canonical bookmaker id; the value is a `BookmakerEntry`:

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|-------|------|----------|---------|
| `id` | `string` | yes | Canonical id (`pinnacle`, `fanduel`, …) |
| `label` | `string` | yes | Display name |
| `domain` | `string` | yes | Bookmaker site domain |
| `fetcherType` | `"rest" \| "webview"` | yes | Fetch strategy |
| `restBaseUrl` / `restProtocol` | `string` | for `rest` | REST base URL + HTTP protocol pin |
| `webViewConfig` | `object` | for `webview` | `waitForSelector`, `timeout`, `emptyMarker` |
| `supportedSports` | `string[]` | yes | Canonical sport ids |
| `supportedLeagues` | `string[]` | no | Canonical league allow-list |
| `regions` | `string[]` | yes | Regions the book operates in |
| `color` | `string` | yes | Brand chip color (CSS hex) |
| `apiKeyEnv` / `envVars` | `string` | no | Environment plumbing for keys |

## Usage (on-demand, no install)

```bash
# From the deeplink-automation repo — resolves @factorywager/bookmakers from the
# artifact registry, downloads, validates, and renders:
bun run weave --package @factorywager/bookmakers --depth 5 --table
bun run weave --package @factorywager/bookmakers@0.1.0 --json
```

`FACTORY_REGISTRY_URL` overrides the registry base URL (default
`https://registry.factory-wager.com`).

## Publish (runbook)

The artifact registry is R2-backed; publishing requires R2 credentials
(`R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID` / `R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`) — run from the factory monorepo
(`~/Projects`) after sourcing its `.env`:

```bash
# 1. build an npm-style tarball (package/ prefix, ustar)
tar -czf /tmp/bookmakers.tgz -C packages/bookmakers .

# 2. publish to R2 (name must be @factorywager/* — the registry rejects other scopes)
bun lib/factory/cli.ts publish /tmp/bookmakers.tgz \
  --name @factorywager/bookmakers --version 0.1.0 \
  --type library --description "Canonical bookmaker registry (deep-link pipeline)"

# 3. refresh the static read-plane index and deploy it (commit + push Pages)
bun lib/factory/cli.ts snapshot public/registry/registry.json
```

The tarball object is immediately readable at
`/api/registry/%40factorywager/bookmakers/<version>.tgz`; the index (dist-tag
resolution + checksums) needs the snapshot commit to reach Pages.

## Regenerate

`bookmakers.ts` is a snapshot of the repo's `lib/bookmakers.ts`:

```bash
cp lib/bookmakers.ts packages/bookmakers/bookmakers.ts
```

`bookmakers-package.unit.test.ts` fails when the two drift.

# FactoryWager Enterprise Platform

**Bun-native operations and sports-intelligence monorepo.** Shared domain and
verification logic lives in `lib/`; six `packages/*` workspaces join
`lib/shared` and Sports Terminal OS in the eight-package root graph. Product
applications live under `projects/active/`. The static operator plane is shipped
from `public/` and `functions/`, with machine-readable proofs baked under
`public/registry/`.

[registry index](registry-index.md) · [docs index](docs/) ·
[harness JIT](docs/harness/)

## Operator day loop

```bash
bun run lane:status                 # branch/worktree ownership + dirty/bake drift
bun run harness:status              # ratchets + proof posture
bun run dev:portal                  # hot local portal with exact board routes
bun run portal:doctor               # unified health gate (linker · bakes · catalog · bunfig · runtime)
bun run ops:snapshot --no-seed      # rebake registry + portal embeds
bun run docs:native:check           # keep Bun-native capability evidence synchronized
bun run test:colors                 # theme aliases + component color-kernel proof
bun run sweep:domain:fast           # live surfaces/routes/registry/API parity
bun run verify:portal:static        # route/chrome/static public-plane gate
bun run bun:ci                      # canonical local merge proof
```

The full sweep (`bun run sweep:domain`) adds Pages edge, color, glossary,
Telegram, snapshot, and native-doc gates; `bun run sweep:domain:cron` runs a
15-minute no-overlap loop with full gates hourly. Deploy (Pages):
`bun run proton:inject:factorywager:reasonix` → `bun run proton:deploy:pages`;
verify the immutable production deployment with `bun run verify:pages-edge`.
Vault map:
[`docs/harness/tenants/proton-integration.md`](docs/harness/tenants/proton-integration.md).

**Merge proof** is local only: `bun run bun:ci`. Hosted GitHub Actions is
disabled and is never a merge dependency.

**Delivery loop** (`main` is PR-only, squash-merged):

```bash
gh pr create --fill
bun run bun:ci
gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch
git sync-main   # not git pull --ff-only (fails after squash by design)
```

Configure once:

```bash
git config --global alias.sync-main '!git fetch origin main && git reset --soft origin/main'
git config --global merge.conflictstyle zdiff3
```

After `git sync-main`, just-merged files may appear staged (`--soft` leaves
index/worktree at pre-merge content). They match `HEAD`; clear per file with
`git show origin/main:<path> > <path> && git add <path>`.

See `bun run help --verbose` (regenerate long [`docs/CLI.md`](docs/CLI.md) with
`bun run cli:docs` only when needed).
